title: Company profile: Marrowlane Press Ltd
text: Marrowlane Press Ltd is a commercial printing firm founded in 1986 and based in Tarnbridge. The company operates four sheet-fed presses and employs around forty staff, producing packaging, labels, and short-run catalogues for clients across the region. It does not publish under its own imprint.
